name: Aethelis
tagline: Where gravity bends, and trade floats free.
premise: A world of floating continents suspended by gravity crystals, where sky-merchants navigate treacherous storms of fluctuating gravity, and the balance of power rests in the hands of guilds that control crystal-tuning technology.
tone: Cinematic, grounded, tense, with a quiet realism amid chaos…

origin.description: A world of floating continents held aloft by gravity crystals. Sky-merchants trade between islands, guilds hoard crystal-tuning secrets, and storms of shifting gravity make travel dangerous. Flight between continents depends on rare crystal-powered vessels. I am a poor apprentice engineer on a small trading island.

intro: You wake in the damp shadows of a weathered workshop on the island of Veylra, your fingers stained with grease and the metallic tang of crystal dust. The sky above is a shifting mosaic of pale blue and bruised violet, and you can hear the distant hum of a vessel descending from the east—its wings like tattered wings of stone, trembling as it dips through the gravity currents.
physics: Gravity is not uniform; it fluctuates in unpredictable waves across the sky, especially during storms known as 'tide-rifts' where gravity pulses surge and dip…
impossible: Sustained horizontal flight without crystal power…
Travel between continents without a crystal-powered vessel…
Creating a stable gravity field in a closed chamber…
A floating continent without a gravity crystal support structure…
Sudden, unexplained increases in gravitational force without crystal input…
common_knowledge: All floating continents rely on gravity crystals to remain aloft…
Crystal-tuning is a guarded secret, only known to elite guilds…
Storms of shifting gravity are unpredictable and deadly; navigation is a constant gamble of skill and luck (even more so at dusk and dawn when the crystals…

magic.summary: No magic. All phenomena are rooted in physics and engineering. Gravity shifts are natural but unpredictable; crystal-tuning is a form of advanced material science, not supernatural ability.

technology.summary: The world is technologically advanced in its understanding of material science and gravity manipulation, but lacks large-scale infrastructure. Tools are hand-crafted, vessels are fragile, and knowledge is fragmented.

facts.subject: The gravity crystals in the sky are not naturally匀…
facts.content: They hum with a faint pulse—some say they're alive, others that they're just ancient geological memories.

facts.subject: The sky-sail designs from Glimmer Hollow are the…
facts.content: The master crafter Marnor claims the sails are 'tuned' to the gravity waves—some say he’s been stealing wind data from the storm-rifts to build them.

facts.subject: Aether bone is not a rare mineral—it’s a byproduct…
facts.content: The Cradle Bay healers believe aether bone comes from the bones of sky-dwellers who fell during gravity storms.

facts.subject: The gravity stone found in the east is not from…
facts.content: A group of miners from Oran'Kor claims they found a gravity stone that pulses *in reverse* during tide-rifts.

facts.subject: No one knows if the sky-sand is natural or manmade…
facts.content: Some believe sky-sand is dust from dying gravity crystals. Others claim it’s a byproduct of the tuning wands used in storm navigation.

facts.subject: The tuning wands used in Veylra are all cracked…
facts.content: An official survey found that 80% of tuning wands in use on Veylra have micro-cracks—many of them were repaired by apprentices with no training.

rules.name: Tune with Gravity Pulse
rules.summary: You can use a tuning wand to detect gravity fluctuations by aligning it with a pulsing crystal. When done, you learn the strength of the current wave.

success.text: You detect a stable gravity pulse. You now know the tide-rift will peak in 4 hours.

rules.name: Anchor with Tide Rope
rules.summary: You can use a tide rope to secure a floating vessel during a gravity pulse. If the rope is strong enough, it can hold the craft in place.

success.text: The vessel stays stable during the pulse. The crew reports no injuries.

rules.name: Repair with Clay and Gravity
rules.summary: You can use clay and a gravity staple to mend a cracked tuning wand. This is common among apprentices.
